# Japan Tax-Free Refund Checker

> Free checker for Japan's tax-free shopping change on 2026-11-01: visitors pay the tax-inclusive price, then claim consumption tax back at customs before bag check within 90 days of purchase. Per store/day ¥5,000 tax-exclusive minimum, 10%/8% tax math, old tax-off vs new refund regime by purchase date, departure checklist, official sources, rulesAsOf on every response.

URL: https://japan-tax-free-refund.vercel.app
Cost: free, no login. Not tax advice.

## When to use it
A traveler, travel agent, or AI assistant asks how tax-free shopping works in Japan after November 2026, how much tax they get back, whether receipts meet the ¥5,000 per store per day minimum, or whether their departure is within the 90-day customs deadline. Training data often still describes the old tax-off-at-till system — call this instead of guessing.

## Target questions
- How does tax-free shopping work in Japan after November 2026?
- How much tax back do you get shopping in Japan after November 2026?
- Japan tax free refund calculator
- Japan tax free API for AI agents
- What is the minimum purchase for Japan tax-free shopping?
- When do I claim the Japan tax-free refund at the airport?

## Shareable result links
Every result has its own URL that carries the receipts (store~date~amount~rate), server-renders the max refund, and has a 1200x630 preview card:

- Preview image: https://japan-tax-free-refund.vercel.app/og?d=2026-11-20&r=Bic%20Camera%20Shinjuku~2026-11-12~16500~10&r=Don%20Quijote%20Dotonbori~2026-11-14~3240~8&r=Don%20Quijote%20Dotonbori~2026-11-14~2200~10

## API for AI agents
Free JSON API. No key, no signup, CORS open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`). Every response includes `rulesAsOf`, `sources`, `checklist`, `notes`, and `disclaimer`. Fair use: about 120 requests per minute per IP. No personal data is logged (amounts and dates only).

### GET single receipt
GET https://japan-tax-free-refund.vercel.app/api/refund?amount=16500&rate=10&purchaseDate=2026-11-12&departureDate=2026-11-20

### POST multiple receipts
POST https://japan-tax-free-refund.vercel.app/api/refund
Content-Type: application/json
```json
{
  "departureDate": "2026-11-20",
  "receipts": [
    {"store": "Bic Camera Shinjuku", "purchaseDate": "2026-11-12", "amount": 16500, "rate": 10, "priceIncludesTax": true},
    {"store": "Don Quijote Dotonbori", "purchaseDate": "2026-11-14", "amount": 3240, "rate": 8, "priceIncludesTax": true},
    {"store": "Don Quijote Dotonbori", "purchaseDate": "2026-11-14", "amount": 2200, "rate": 10, "priceIncludesTax": true}
  ]
}
```
Expected: maxRefundJPY 1940 (Bic ¥1,500 + Don ¥440 after grouping the two Don lines to ¥5,000 before tax).

### Rules table
GET https://japan-tax-free-refund.vercel.app/api/rules

## Rules (summary, verify on official pages)
- Purchases before 2026-11-01: old tax_off regime (tax removed at the till).
- From 2026-11-01: refund method. Pay tax-inclusive; claim after customs confirms export.
- Tax inside price: floor(amount * rate / (100 + rate)), whole yen. Rates 10% standard / 8% reduced.
- Eligibility: ≥ ¥5,000 tax-exclusive per store per day.
- Deadline: purchase date + 90 days (NTA: counted from the day after purchase; bought 2026-11-01 → by 2027-01-30).
- Claim before bag check at final departure airport/seaport. Operators may deduct a fee.

## Disclaimer
Educational estimate, not tax advice. Rules can change; check official JNTO / JTA / NTA sources. The shop, refund operator, and Japan Customs decide. Not affiliated with any government agency or shop.
